dialog.speaker: npc:hr
dialog.tr: Görüşmeyi ancak 19.30'a alabildik, kusura bakmayın. Ekip zaten burada oluyor.
dialog.en: We could only fit you in at 7:30 p.m., apologies. The team is always here anyway.

dialog.speaker: npc:hr
dialog.en: Dinner is on the company. Every evening.

choices.en: Don't ask. Count the occupied desks
A job is a job. Chase the offer

sor.tr: Sordun. "Sonuç odaklıyız, saate bakmayız" dediler. Duvardaki saat de durmuştu.
sor.en: You asked. "We're results-driven, we don't watch the clock," they said. The wall clock had stopped as well.

coach.tr: Saate bakmıyorlar. Saat de durumu anlamış, durmuş.
coach.en: They don't watch the clock. The clock got the message and stopped.

say.tr: Saydın: 20.15'te yirmi iki kişi masasındaydı, üçü yemek yiyordu. Teklif gelirse ne soracağını biliyorsun.
say.en: You counted. At 8:15 p.m., twenty-two people were at their desks. Three were eating. If an offer comes, you know what to ask.

coach.tr: Yirmi iki dolu masa. Sorulmamış sorunun cevabı.
coach.en: Twenty-two occupied desks. The answer to a question nobody asked.

devam.tr: Görüşme iyi geçti, teklif geldi, kabul ettin. İlk hafta eve en erken 21.10'da girdin.
devam.en: The interview went well, the offer came, you accepted. In week one the earliest you got home was 9:10 p.m.

coach.tr: Akşam yemeği gerçekten şirketten. Akşam da.
coach.en: Dinner really is on the company. So is the evening.

intent.setup: akşam 19.30'a konan mülakatta ofisin tamamen dolu olması
